Dear Tokyo Art Book Fair team,

TABF's reputation for bringing together independently published art books and zines with a genuine curatorial sensibility is what draws me to reach out about exhibiting at a future edition. GEGYjiji

immediate_push.email_en:
Subject: Inquiry from illustrator GEGYjiji — watercolor zine / consignment possibility

Dear UTRECHT team,

I have long admired how UTRECHT brings together artist books, zines, and illustrated works that sit quietly between fine art and everyday life, and I think my work may belong in that same conversation. I am GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, and in 2021 I published Colour Diary, a small illustration collection grown from a daily watercolor practice that documents domestic interiors, neighborhood light, and the quiet texture of city life — much of it observed here in Tokyo. My work has been shown in Tokyo most recently as part of Tide from China, a group exhibition at ACG_Labo in Harajuku in 2023, and I am now looking to place printed work or original pieces in spaces where that kind of attentive, intimate scale feels at home. I would love to explore whether a consignment arrangement or a small exhibition might be a possibility, and you are welcome to see more of my work on Instagram at @gegyjiji. Thank you very much for your time, and I hope to hear from you.

GEGYjiji

Subject: Consignment Inquiry — Colour Diary / GEGYjiji

Dear B&B team,

I have long admired how your shelves bring together books, zines, and art in a way that feels genuinely curated rather than simply stocked, and Shimokitazawa feels like the right neighborhood for the kind of quiet, observational work I make. I am GEGYjiji, a Tokyo-based Chinese watercolor artist, and I am writing to ask whether B&B accepts consignment inquiries for self-published artist books. My first illustration collection, Colour Diary, grew out of a daily watercolor diary practice I began in 2020 — it documents domestic interiors, neighborhood light, and small moments of urban life in a format I think would sit naturally alongside the books you carry. You can find a fuller sense of my work on Instagram at @gegyjiji. I would love to hear about your current process for consignment, and I am also happy to visit the shop in person if that would be easier.

Warm regards,
GEGYjiji

Subject: Consignment inquiry — Colour Diary (illustration collection) by GEGYjiji

Dear COW BOOKS team,

I admire how carefully your Nakameguro shop is curated — the sense that every book on the shelf has been chosen by someone who actually reads, which is rare and matters to me as both a reader and an artist. I am GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor illustrator based in Tokyo, and I would love to ask whether you might consider stocking my first illustration collection, Colour Diary (色彩日記), a small-format book that grew out of a daily watercolor diary practice I began in 2020. The work focuses on quiet Tokyo interiors, neighborhood light, cats, and the particular way a city looks when you are still learning to belong to it — themes I think might sit naturally alongside the books you already carry. You can see my recent work on Instagram at @gegyjiji, and I am happy to bring a copy of the book in person if a visit would be easier than corresponding by email. Thank you sincerely for your time, and I hope to hear from you.

GEGYjiji

exploration_layer.email_en:
Subject: Booth Inquiry — GEGYjiji / Watercolor Artist

Hello TOKIO ART BOOK FAIR team,

I came across your fair and was drawn to its invitation-based format and the kind of intimate, artist-made publications it brings together — it feels like exactly the right context for the work I make. I am GEGYjiji, a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, and my first illustration collection Colour Diary grew out of a daily watercolor diary practice I have kept since 2020, documenting quiet domestic moments, Tokyo neighborhoods, and interior light in a small, personal scale. I would love to understand how the booth application or recommendation process works for 2026, and whether there is still an opportunity to participate. You can find my recent work on Instagram at @gegyjiji, and I am happy to share any additional materials you might need.

Thank you for your time, and I hope to hear from you.

GEGYjiji

件名: TOKIO ART BOOK FAIR 2026 出展申請について（ご確認のお願い）

突然のご連絡、失礼いたします。東京を拠点に活動する中国人水彩画家、GEGYjiji（ジェジー）と申します。TOKIO ART BOOK FAIRは、国内外のアーティストや出版者が集まる招待制の形式で運営されていると伺っており、私の作品との親和性を感じ、今回ご連絡させていただきました。私は2020年から毎日の水彩記録「diary」を続けており、赤い壁、路地、プール、緑の池など、ごく普通の日常の景色を感動的なシーンとして描き溜めてきた作品をまとめた初のイラスト集『Colour Diary』を2021年に刊行いたしました。2026年の出展に向けた申請方法や締め切り、お手続きの詳細をご教示いただけますと幸いです。作品はInstagram（@gegyjiji）よりご覧いただけます。

どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

GEGYjiji
